headline: NVIDIA describes an internally deployed multi-agent assistant for AI-factory operations
summary: NVIDIA’s 4 November technical blog describes an AI Factory Operations Agent that it says is in internal production for DGX SuperPOD operations. The reported system uses domain agents to correlate cluster signals and recommend actions through a Kubernetes control plane, per-session sandboxes and read-only inspection credentials. The source reports no measured operational outcomes, and this activation did not independently verify the deployment or controls.
